clue.text: Safe stretch of water

definitions.meaning: in good condition, undamaged, as in 'safe and well'
a narrow channel or inlet of the sea, such as Plymouth's

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both healthy or secure and a strait of sea between two land masses.

clue.text: Lines of poetry or music

definitions.meaning: a stanza or verse of a poem
the five-line sets on which notes are written

explanation.surface: A simple question of which lines are meant, verse or score.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names both verses of a poem and the ruled sets of lines on manuscript paper.

clue.text: What's more it's a sincere conversion

indicators.note: a conversion changes something into another form, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A remark that someone's change of heart is genuine and welcome.
explanation.walkthrough: 'it's' is a link; 'conversion' rearranges A SINCERE.
explanation.definitionFit: A rise or addition is literally more of something, so the noun fits 'what's more'.

clue.text: Misfortune for the other side

definitions.meaning: a setback or defeat
the back or opposite face, as of a coin

explanation.definitionFit: A setback is one sense; the back face of a coin or page is another.

clue.text: Demonstrate a member how to rise

parts.note: to demonstrate is to show
a member is a limb, here a leg

explanation.surface: An instructor teaching a club member how to stand up.
explanation.walkthrough: The printed text runs words together and reads 'to' where the wordplay needs 'a'. 'Show a leg' is an old naval call to get out of bed.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom is a command to wake and get up, so it is a way of rising in the morning.

clue.text: About to enter seaside activity, taking the air

indicators.note: one piece goes into the middle of the other, as a swimmer enters the sea

parts.note: bathing is swimming in the sea
re means about or concerning

explanation.surface: A holidaymaker about to go into the sea for a swim, enjoying the fresh breeze.
explanation.definitionFit: Inhaling is drawing in air, so the phrase describes the act.

clue.text: One who tries to steer a boat

parts.note: to con a ship is to direct its steering
a tender is a small boat serving a larger ship

explanation.surface: A rower or helmsman attempting to guide a boat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to' is a link; CON is a nautical term for directing a ship's course.
explanation.definitionFit: A competitor is someone who strives or attempts to win.

clue.text: Strengthen the coastline

definitions.meaning: to prop up or support
the land at the edge of the sea

explanation.surface: Building sea defences along a beach.
explanation.definitionFit: To prop with timber is one sense; the sea's edge is the other.

clue.text: Hereditary factor for Mr Kelly?

definitions.meaning: a unit of DNA passing traits from parent to child
... Kelly, the American dancer and actor of Singin' in the Rain

explanation.surface: Wondering which inherited trait a man called Kelly carries.
explanation.definitionFit: A unit of heredity shares its name with the first name of a famous Hollywood dancer.

clue.text: All things stemming from Eve's ruin

indicators.note: what stems from something is made out of it, so the following letters are reworked into a new word

parts.note: the name Eve with its s kept as a letter

explanation.surface: Everything in creation springing from Eve's fall in Eden.
explanation.walkthrough: 'stemming from' rearranges EVES and RUIN together; 'ruin' looks like the signal but is part of the fodder.
explanation.definitionFit: The cosmos is the sum total of everything that exists.

clue.text: New organisation takes blame for cover up

indicators.note: organising something arranges it afresh, so these letters are put in a new order

parts.note: to take the rap is to take the blame

explanation.surface: A new organisation accepts responsibility for a scandal being hushed up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'organisation' rearranges NEW into ENW; 'takes' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: To wrap something round is to envelop and conceal it.

clue.text: Continental destination when going by first-class return

parts.note: as can mean when, as in 'as I left'

indicators.note: a return journey comes back, so this piece is read backwards

parts.note: A1 means first-rate, the top grade in Lloyd's Register

explanation.surface: A traveller heading abroad by first-class return ticket.
explanation.walkthrough: 'going by' is a link. A1, written with the digit read as I, turns round to give IA.
explanation.definitionFit: Travelling to a continent makes the largest of the continents a destination.

clue.text: Pinch your old-fashioned secret

parts.note: to pinch is to steal
thy is the archaic form of your

explanation.surface: A conspiratorial line about stealing someone's quaint old secret.
explanation.definitionFit: Something done furtively is done covertly, out of sight.

clue.text: Anticipation of what might be set for tea

indicators.note: the letters might be something else when rearranged, so they are reordered

explanation.surface: Looking forward to whatever is laid out for afternoon tea.
explanation.walkthrough: 'of what' is a link; 'might be' rearranges SET FOR TEA.
explanation.definitionFit: A sample in advance gives a sense of what is coming, so it is a kind of expectation.

clue.text: Travel East on vessel in high spirits

indicators.note: the vessel and east go inside the word for high spirits

parts.note: joy is delight, high spirits

indicators.note: east is placed on, so coming after, the vessel

parts.note: an urn is a vase or container
E is the compass abbreviation for east

explanation.surface: A joyful voyage eastward aboard a ship.
explanation.definitionFit: A trip from one place to another is travel, as noun or verb.

clue.text: Rotor-arm?

parts.note: read cryptically as a firearm whose chamber rotates, an arm that turns

explanation.definitionFit: A pistol with a rotating cylinder is a weapon, an arm, that spins.

clue.text: Fancy a title for a Lennon song

definitions.meaning: to fancy is to suppose or picture in the mind

definitions.text: a title for a Lennon song
definitions.meaning: John Lennon's 1971 song of that name

explanation.surface: A question about naming a song by John Lennon.
explanation.definitionFit: To picture something in the mind is the verb; it is also the name of Lennon's best-known solo single.

clue.text: Doctor to ask us about a dish we may have eaten abroad

definitions.text: dish we may have eaten abroad

parts.note: MO is a medical officer, a doctor

indicators.note: about here means scattered around, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A doctor asking holidaymakers about a meal they had overseas.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to' is a link; 'about' rearranges ASK US into USSAK, between MO and A.
explanation.definitionFit: A Greek baked dish of aubergine and minced meat, typically met on holiday.

clue.text: Where the butts of a a party congregate?

definitions.text: Where the butts of a a party congregate?

parts.words: Where the butts of a a party congregate?
parts.note: butts read as cigarette ends rather than targets of jokes, gathered at a party

explanation.walkthrough: The repeated 'a' is a printing slip.
explanation.definitionFit: A dish for cigarette ash and stubs is where the ends end up.

clue.text: They're seen in court, heard in church

definitions.meaning: the opening strokes of points on a tennis court
acts of worship and liturgy

explanation.surface: Things witnessed at a tennis match and listened to at worship.
explanation.definitionFit: Tennis has its serves, and a church holds forms of worship of the same name.

clue.text: Set of rules the expert may break

definitions.meaning: a system of laws or regulations
a cipher that a skilled cryptographer cracks

explanation.surface: A specialist flouting the regulations.
explanation.definitionFit: A body of rules is one sense; a cipher cracked by codebreakers is the other.

clue.text: It could kill, though not down as a poison

parts.note: the opposite of down is up
taken as written

explanation.surface: A warning that something lethal is not, after all, a gentle sedative.
explanation.walkthrough: The upas is a Javanese tree whose sap was used to poison arrows; 'It could kill, though' sets the scene.
explanation.definitionFit: The Javanese upas tree yields a toxic latex used on arrow tips.

clue.text: Join in a very quiet finale

parts.note: pp, pianissimo, is the musical mark for very quiet
a finale is the end

explanation.surface: A singer joining the chorus softly at the close.
explanation.definitionFit: To attach something at the end is to add it on.

clue.text: Pack before mounting

definitions.meaning: to cram or fill tightly
a taxidermist fills an animal's skin before mounting it for display

explanation.surface: Loading a bag before getting on a horse.
explanation.definitionFit: To cram is one sense; filling a dead animal's skin, done before it is mounted, is the other.

clue.text: Everyone's included in wicked song

indicators.note: one word goes inside the other, as a member is included in a group

parts.note: bad means wicked
everyone is all; the 's stands for 'is'

explanation.surface: A naughty song in which everyone takes part.
explanation.definitionFit: A narrative poem or slow sentimental song.

clue.text: Arrests drunkard in retreat-or drunkards

indicators.note: retreating means going backwards, so the whole run is read in reverse

parts.note: to arrest is to stop
a sot is a habitual drinker

explanation.surface: Police stopping a drinker as they back off, or a whole crowd of them.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in retreat' turns STOPS SOT round as a whole to TOS SPOTS; 'or' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Toss-pots is an old term for heavy drinkers.

clue.text: Cattle drive

definitions.meaning: a bullock, a castrated male of the herd
to guide a vehicle

explanation.surface: Herding livestock along a road.
explanation.definitionFit: A young castrated bull is one sense; guiding a car is the other.

clue.text: Kind of dive lorry-drivers try to avoid

definitions.meaning: a dive where the body bends double then straightens
a truck skidding so the trailer folds against the cab

explanation.surface: A dive that truck drivers would rather not perform.
explanation.definitionFit: Folding in two at the hips names both a diving move and an articulated lorry's dangerous skid.
